subject: Private VPC architecture review — next steps
messages:

Subject: Private VPC architecture review — next steps

Hi Sam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can move toward a Private/VPC review: 

- Key needs you described: dedicated VPC with customer-managed network, KMS integration for keys, and audit log retention for 12 months.
- Primary technical goals for the architecture review: network zoning, peering options, firewall rules, and required IAM roles.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute Private/VPC architecture review (technical deep dive) with our Sales Engineer, Marissa Cole, and your infra lead. Suggested windows:
- Wed Feb 25, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Feb 26, 13:00–14:00 PT

Please let me know which of those works or propose alternatives. Also attaching the one-pager we referenced and a very rough VPC diagram — happy to update once we confirm attendees.

Attachments: FintechCo_Network_Summary.pdf (PDF), VPC_diagram_v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,

- We'll want to confirm network CIDR sizing and whether transit gateway or VPC peering is recommended.
- We need clarity on outbound egress controls and any required proxying.
- We'll bring a representative from security if there are SOC/controls questions.

Sending over a short network summary we pulled together — attaches here. See you Thursday.

Perfect — thanks Sam. I'll put the invite on the calendar for Thu Feb 26, 13:00–14:00 PT and include a short agenda. Marissa will lead the technical deep dive.

Agenda (proposed, feel free to edit):
1) Introductions and scope (5m)
2) FintechCo current infra overview (10m)
3) Proposed Private/VPC deployment options (25m)
   - VPC peering vs transit gateway
   - CIDR sizing and subnets
   - Egress/ingress controls and NAT/proxy considerations
4) Integration points (KMS, audit logs, IAM) (15m)
5) Next steps and action items (5m)

Marissa — can you confirm you're available and whether you'd like any prep docs from Sam/Priya beforehand? Also, Sam/Priya — please add any additional attendees (security, network) when you accept the invite.

I'll attach the provisional invite and a short slide with our recommended checklist for private deployments.

Thanks,
Aditya

Thanks — I'm available Thu 2/26 13:00 PT and will lead the technical portion. A couple quick asks before the call so we can make the session productive: 
- Can you share the exact VPC CIDRs and whether you use a transit gateway today?
- Any corporate proxy or egress appliance we should know about?
- Would you like us to run a brief pre-check (connectivity checklist) with one of your infra engineers prior to the call?

If you can drop the answers in the calendar invite or share a short doc, that'd be great. I'll prepare a proposed architecture diagram (variants) and a checklist for required IAM roles and KMS setup.

See you Thursday — I'll also include a Zoom link and the slide deck in the invite.
